approach: Add two prose-only `[[default]]` entries (`version-pins`, `hermetic-checks`) to `defaults.toml`. The first sentence of each carries the stance, because `DefaultsModel::render` prints only that sentence (defaults.rs:55-69, `first_sentence` at :77). Raise `BudgetSet::Reader` from 2_000 to 2_200 (athena-context/src/lib.rs:176). Replace the hard-coded `of 2000` in run_pin_tests.rs:1625 with the budget constant. Update the `budget reader` line in docs/system-facts.md to the computed size and new budget. Append D181 to docs/decisions.md. Add a CHANGELOG entry. Add one test in defaults.rs that parses the real `defaults.toml`. Nothing is built for repin: `cargo run -p xtask -- repin` exists (D154; xtask/src/main.rs:50, :686). It rewrites only `claude_version`, so the entry says pins are exact and moved by repin, naming the Claude Code pin as the example.

decisions.choice: Put the stance in the first sentence of each entry and let the later sentences carry scope and the 'Prose-only: no loop code enforces it yet.' marker.
decisions.reason: `first_sentence` cuts at the first '. ' (defaults.rs:77-83), so the reader sees only sentence one. The producer and verifier get the full statement through `get`. The outcome-check entry (defaults.toml:89) uses the same shape.

rejected.option: Put the prose-only marker in the first sentence
rejected.why: It would spend reader tokens on a marker the reader does not need. Full statements already carry it to the producer and verifier.

rejected.option: Put the stance in a later sentence
rejected.why: The reader would never see it, so it would still ask the user.

decisions.choice: Change the reader budget constant from 2_000 to 2_200 and rewrite its nearby comment to say the reader budget was raised by D181.
decisions.reason: The reader set is 1998 of 2000 (docs/system-facts.md:25), so two new lines cannot fit. The lib.rs:177-179 comment says a budget never rises, and the code should not contradict itself. D181 records the departure from D170.

rejected.why: The set has 2 tokens of headroom (D170), and the request asks for a raise.

rejected.option: Leave the stance only in the producer or verifier brief
rejected.why: The reader decides whether to ask the user, so it must see the stance.

decisions.choice: Replace the literal `of 2000` in run_pin_tests.rs:1625 with the value `athena_context::BudgetSet::Reader.budget()`.
decisions.reason: The test then follows the constant, as the verifier line at :1620 already does, so a later budget change cannot leave a stale literal.

rejected.why: It leaves a second place to edit on the next change.

decisions.choice: The version-pins statement names `claude_version` as the example pin and names the repin command; it does not claim repin moves every pin.
decisions.reason: repin rewrites only the `claude_version` line (xtask/src/main.rs:16 doc; :726 `repin_at`). The statement must not overstate it, which was a factual slip in the earlier attempt.

rejected.option: Say repin moves all version pins
rejected.why: It is false for other pins, and the verifier would reject it.

files.purpose: Append `version-pins` and `hermetic-checks` entries, each with the stance in its first sentence, scope, a Prose-only marker and a source citing the two jobs.
Add the test that parses the real defaults.toml and checks both ids, their key phrases and the rendered reader lines.
Raise `BudgetSet::Reader` to 2_200 and fix the comment at :177-179 so it names the reader exception (D181).
Replace the literal `of 2000` at :1625 with the reader budget constant.
Set the `budget reader` line to the computed size of 2200.
Append D181 with Provenance naming the root cause, the two jobs and the departure from D170.
Add an Unreleased entry naming the root cause (defaults silent on pin and ambient-tool policy), the two entries and the budget raise.

steps: Append `version-pins` to defaults.toml. The statement's first sentence says version pins, such as `claude_version`, are exact and never auto-floated, and only the person running Athena changes one, through the existing `cargo run -p xtask -- repin` command. Later sentences name the scope and say 'Prose-only: no loop code enforces it yet.' Set applies_to to ["code", "config", "build"] and the source to the two jobs.

Append `hermetic-checks` to defaults.toml. The first sentence says a check never depends on inherited environment or ambient tools, the runner passes every path a check needs, and any preferred-versus-fallback tool choice is recorded in the check output. Add the Prose-only marker. Set applies_to to ["code", "config", "build", "tests"].
Change `BudgetSet::Reader` to 2_200 in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs:176 and reword the comment at :177-179 to say the reader budget alone was raised, by D181.
In run_pin_tests.rs:1625 format the budget in with `athena_context::BudgetSet::Reader.budget()` in place of the literal 2000.
Add the new test to crates/athena-data/src/defaults.rs, following `behavior_evidence_default_leads_with_the_core_rule` (:129).
Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets`. Copy the computed reader size into the `budget reader` line of docs/system-facts.md as `<size> of 2200`.

Append D181 to the end of docs/decisions.md in the D180 layout (Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance). The Provenance bullet names the root cause, jobs 20261016-005805-p806 and 20261025-183644-t67q, the measured reader size, and that this departs from D170's rule that budgets never rise to fit a set. Do not edit any earlier entry.
Add one Unreleased entry at the top of the Added list in CHANGELOG.md. It names the root cause, the two entries, the budget raise from 2000 to 2200, the existing repin command and D181.
Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`. Check with `git diff --stat` that only the seven deliverables changed.

risks.risk: The two new lines push the reader set past 2200. The estimate is 140-145 tokens on top of 1998, about 2140, but it is not measured.
risks.mitigation: Keep each first sentence to about 200 bytes. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets` and read the computed size. If it is over, shorten the sentences rather than raise the budget again.

risks.risk: A '. ' inside a first sentence (for example 'e.g. ') cuts the rendered line short and drops part of the stance.
risks.mitigation: The new test asserts the full first sentence appears in `render()`. Write the sentences with colons and commas only.

risks.risk: New text trips the boundary scan or the personal-data scan.
risks.mitigation: Avoid the banned words and any email-like text, use 'the person running Athena', and run `cargo test -p xtask --test policy`.

risks.risk: The system-facts line is off by one because the size is ⌈bytes/3⌉.
risks.mitigation: Edit defaults.toml first, run `system_facts_budgets_match_computed`, and copy the computed size from its failure message.

The Provenance bullet names the root cause (defaults silent on pin and ambient-tool policy), jobs 20261016-005805-p806 and 20261025-183644-t67q, and says the entry departs from D170's rule that budgets never rise to fit a set. demonstrations.method: Add a test in defaults.rs `mod tests`, for example `pin_and_hermetic_check_defaults_reach_the_reader`. It runs `DefaultsModel::parse(REPO_DEFAULTS)`, gets both ids, and asserts their statements contain 'exact', 'never auto-floated', 'repin' and 'ambient'. It asserts the full statements contain 'Prose-only', and that `model.render()` contains the lines `- version-pins [` and `- hermetic-checks [` with those first sentences. Then run the whole suite.
demonstrations.command: cargo test --locked -p athena-data pin_and_hermetic && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: The new test passes. On the base tree `get("version-pins")` returns None and the test fails. The budgets tests (`system_facts_budgets_match_computed`, `the_reader_headroom_rows_equal_the_budget_figures_and_name_shared_files`), the run_pin_tests headroom test and `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` all pass. The policy test shows the new text has none of the words in `boundary_words()` (xtask/tests/policy.rs:88).
demonstrations.fails_without: The test asserts both ids exist and appear in the rendered reader text. On the base tree defaults.toml has neither id, so `get` returns None, the unwrap fails and the test fails. A second assertion fails if a new entry's stance sits after the first sentence, because `render` would not show it.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points `DefaultsModel::parse` and `DefaultsModel::render` (defaults.rs:36, :58). The fixture is `REPO_DEFAULTS = include_str!("../../../defaults.toml")` (defaults.rs:89), the real file and not a double. The seam exists; the plan adds only the test. The render output is what the reader loads, as run_pin_tests.rs:1629-1635 and budgets.rs:34 compose it.

demonstrations.method: Run the formatter check and clippy exactly as Athena's checks do.
demonstrations.observes: Both exit 0. The new test and the constant edit introduce no warnings.
demonstrations.fails_without: A badly formatted test or an unused import would fail `fmt` or `clippy`.
